mapper.sql: o.id, o.order_no, o.user_id, o.house_id, o.check_in_date, o.check_out_date, o.nights, o.guest_num, o.unit_price, o.total_amount, o.contact_name, o.contact_phone, o.remark, o.status, o.pay_type, o.pay_time, o.created_by, o.creation_date, o.modify_by, o.modify_date
mapper.select: SELECT , h.title AS house_title, h.cover_img AS house_cover, h.city AS house_city, h.address AS house_address, h.host_id AS host_id, u.username, u.real_name AS user_real_name FROM booking_order o LEFT JOIN house h ON o.house_id = h.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE o.id = #{id}

SELECT , h.title AS house_title, h.cover_img AS house_cover, h.city AS house_city, h.address AS house_address, h.host_id AS host_id, u.username, u.real_name AS user_real_name FROM booking_order o LEFT JOIN house h ON o.house_id = h.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE o.order_no = #{orderNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO booking_order (order_no, user_id, house_id, check_in_date, check_out_date, nights, guest_num, unit_price, total_amount, contact_name, contact_phone, remark, status, pay_type, pay_time, created_by, creation_date) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{houseId}, #{checkInDate}, #{checkOutDate}, #{nights}, #{guestNum}, #{unitPrice}, #{totalAmount}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{remark}, #{status}, #{payType}, #{payTime}, #{createdBy}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, house_id, check_in_date, check_out_date, status FROM booking_order WHERE house_id = #{houseId} AND status IN (0, 1, 2) ORDER BY check_in_date ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM booking_order WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM booking_order WHERE status IN (1, 2, 3)

SELECT MONTH(creation_date) AS name, IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS value FROM booking_order WHERE status IN (1, 2, 3) AND YEAR(creation_date) = #{year} GROUP BY MONTH(creation_date) ORDER BY name ASC
SELECT status AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM booking_order GROUP BY status ORDER BY status ASC
SELECT h.title AS name, COUNT(o.id) AS value FROM house h LEFT JOIN booking_order o ON h.id = o.house_id AND o.status IN (1, 2, 3) GROUP BY h.id, h.title ORDER BY value DESC, h.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
